questions.question: What is the minimum length of a memorized secret chosen by the subscriber?
questions.answer: Memorized secrets chosen by the subscriber must be at least 8 characters in length [1].

questions.question: Should verifiers require users to change their passwords periodically?
questions.answer: No, verifiers should not require memorized secrets (passwords) to be changed arbitrarily or periodically, unless there is a user request or evidence of authenticator compromise [S1, S2].

questions.question: How many failed authentication attempts may a verifier allow before rate limiting?
questions.answer: Unless otherwise specified for a given authenticator, verifiers shall limit consecutive failed authentication attempts on a single account to no more than 100 [1].

questions.question: How many layers does the encoder of the base Transformer have?
questions.answer: The encoder of the Transformer is composed of a stack of 𝑁 = 6 N=6 identical layers [1].

questions.question: What BLEU score does the big Transformer reach on WMT 2014 English-to-German?
questions.answer: The big Transformer model achieves a BLEU score of 28.4 on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task [1].

questions.question: What does the calibre demo document demonstrate?
questions.answer: The calibre demo document demonstrates the ability of the calibre DOCX Input plugin to convert various typographic features from a Microsoft Word document into a modern ebook format [1].
